title: Grilled Eggplant Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with grilled eggplant, warm Mediterranean sauce, and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat.
Brush the eggplant with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the eggplant for 3-4 minutes per side, until tender and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, toast the wrap on the grill for a minute, until lightly browned.
Slice the grilled eggplant into thin strips.
Spread the Mediterranean sauce on the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Arrange the eggplant strips, cucumber, tomato, and parsley on top of the sauce.
If using feta cheese, crumble it on top.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
